tldr_zh: OpenAI推出GPT-5.6降價、Google發布機器人AI、大語言模型安全漏洞曝光、蘋果Q3銷售強勁創新高。
tldr_en: OpenAI launches cheaper GPT-5.6, Google debuts Gemini Robotics ER 2, LLM security flaw discovered, Apple Q3 sales surge.

items.title_zh: OpenAI推出GPT-5.6降低成本，助企業規模化部署
items.title_en: OpenAI Launches GPT-5.6 with Lower Pricing for Enterprise Scale
items.summary_zh: OpenAI發布GPT-5.6，針對Luna和Terra應用進一步降低定價，推動更高效的模型以幫助企業大規模部署AI工作流。此舉標誌OpenAI在成本效益方面的持續優化，加強其在企業市場的競爭力。
items.summary_en: OpenAI unveiled GPT-5.6 with reduced pricing for Luna and Terra, deploying more efficient models to help enterprises scale AI workflows. This demonstrates OpenAI's continued optimization of cost-effectiveness and strengthens its competitive position in the enterprise market.

items.title_zh: Google DeepMind推出Gemini Robotics ER 2強化機器人視覺與協作
items.title_en: Google DeepMind Unveils Gemini Robotics ER 2 for Advanced Robot Vision
items.summary_zh: Google DeepMind發布Gemini Robotics ER 2，在視頻理解、任務編排和多機器人協作方面實現重大突破。該模型幫助機器人推理分析、協同工作並解決現實任務，代表機器人應用的重要進展。
items.summary_en: Google DeepMind released Gemini Robotics ER 2, achieving significant breakthroughs in video understanding, task orchestration, and multi-robot collaboration. The model enables robots to reason, collaborate, and solve real-world tasks, marking important progress in robotics applications.

items.title_zh: 研究揭示大語言模型存在根本性安全漏洞無法完全防護
items.title_en: Fundamental Security Flaw Makes LLMs Inherently Vulnerable to Attacks
items.summary_zh: MIT科技評論報導，研究人員在國際機器學習會議上發表論文指出，大語言模型因工作原理的根本性缺陷，不可能完全防護不受駭客攻擊。這一發現對此技術的安全性具有重大影響，引發業界對AI安全的深刻思考。
items.summary_en: MIT Technology Review reports that researchers presented findings at a top AI conference showing LLMs have a fundamental flaw making them impossible to fully secure against hacks. This discovery has major implications for AI safety and security.

items.title_zh: 蘋果Q3銷售強勁成長，iPhone銷售躍升22%達542.5億美元
items.title_en: Apple Q3 Sales Surge with iPhone Revenue Up 22% to $54.25 Billion
items.summary_zh: 蘋果第三季財報顯示，儘管全球記憶體短缺，但iPhone銷售仍勁升22%至542.5億美元，Mac銷售更增長29%至103.5億美元，帶動整體營收達1,094億美元。強勁表現反映蘋果產品的市場吸引力。
items.summary_en: Apple's Q3 earnings reveal iPhone sales jumped 22% to $54.25 billion and Mac sales increased 29% to $10.35 billion, driving total revenue to $109.4 billion despite global memory shortages. The strong performance demonstrates Apple's market appeal.

items.title_zh: 蘋果儲備庫存應對重大供應短缺，存貨翻倍至111億美元
items.title_en: Apple Stockpiles $11.1 Billion in Inventory Amid Supply Concerns
items.summary_zh: 蘋果為應對"重大供應限制"，將庫存增加至111億美元，較去年9月的57億美元翻倍。此舉反映蘋果對全球供應鏈風險的警惕，為可能的短缺做好準備。
items.summary_en: Apple increased inventory to $11.1 billion, nearly double the $5.7 billion from last September, to prepare for anticipated significant supply constraints. This move reflects Apple's caution about global supply chain risks.

items.title_zh: 蒂姆·庫克提示推出iCloud Plus AI付費層級滿足高端用戶
items.title_en: Tim Cook Hints at iCloud Plus AI Tier for Power Users
items.summary_zh: 蘋果執行長庫克在財報會議上表示，將推出iCloud Plus升級方案讓用戶提升Apple Intelligence和Siri的使用額度，滿足對AI功能有高需求的用戶。體現蘋果在AI服務變現方面的新策略。
items.summary_en: Apple CEO Tim Cook indicated during earnings call that iCloud Plus will offer upgrade options allowing users to increase their Apple Intelligence and Siri usage limits. This reflects Apple's strategy to monetize AI features for power users.

items.title_zh: Xbox執行長發布備忘錄欲扭轉頹勢，力爭2027年底前重啟成長
items.title_en: Xbox CEO Outlines Recovery Plan After Major Restructuring
items.summary_zh: Xbox執行長Asha Sharma在內部備忘錄中宣布，經過大規模重組和工作室分拆後，計劃於2027財年底前讓Xbox重返增長軌跡。此舉標誌Xbox在經歷困難後的戰略轉向。
items.summary_en: Xbox CEO Asha Sharma outlined plans in a memo to return Xbox to growth by end of fiscal 2027 following major restructuring that included layoffs and studio spinoffs. This marks a strategic turnaround for the troubled gaming division.

items.title_zh: 聯邦法官認定川普政府未提供足夠證據制裁Anthropic
items.title_en: Federal Judge Questions Trump Admin's Evidence Against Anthropic
items.summary_zh: 聯邦法官裁定，川普政府未能提交充分證據證實Anthropic構成供應鏈風險，對政府禁止其AI技術的措施提出質疑。此判決可能影響美國對AI企業的監管政策。
items.summary_en: A federal judge ruled that the Trump administration has not presented sufficient evidence to justify labeling Anthropic a supply-chain risk, casting doubt on the government's ban. This decision could affect US regulatory policy toward AI companies.

items.title_zh: 台灣開源基金會成立投資3億元推動本土AI工程三年計畫
items.title_en: Taiwan Open Source Foundation Launches $30M Three-Year AI Initiative
items.summary_zh: 台灣開源基金會正式成立，未來三年投入新台幣3億元推動台灣開源AI工程，建立千人在地技術社群。此舉旨在強化台灣的AI主權能力，抓住開源時代的競爭機遇。
items.summary_en: Taiwan's TAIONE Open Source Foundation officially launched with plans to invest NT$300 million over three years in open-source AI engineering and build a 1,000-person local tech community. This initiative aims to strengthen Taiwan's AI sovereignty and seize opportunities in the open-source era.

items.title_zh: Linux網路流量排程系統高風險漏洞曝光，可升權至Root
items.title_en: Critical Linux Kernel Vulnerability Allows Privilege Escalation to Root
items.summary_zh: 資安廠商揭露Linux核心漏洞CVE-2026-53264，CVSS評分7.8分，存在於net/sched子系統，攻擊者可利用使用後釋放(UAF)漏洞讓低權限用戶升級至Root權限。Linux核心上游已完成修補。
items.summary_en: Security researchers disclosed critical Linux kernel vulnerability CVE-2026-53264 (CVSS 7.8) in the net/sched subsystem, allowing unprivileged local users to escalate to root privileges via a use-after-free condition. Linux kernel upstream has been patched.

items.title_zh: 美國對伊朗發動"強大"空襲，雙方導彈攻擊再次升級
items.title_en: US Launches Heavy Strikes on Iran After Attempted Attack
items.summary_zh: 短暫停火後，美國和伊朗雙方重啟導彈攻擊。美國以伊朗對美軍基地的襲擊為由發動"強大"空襲，標誌著中東局勢進一步升溫。
items.summary_en: After a period of relative calm, the US and Iran have resumed missile attacks. The US launched heavy strikes against Iran following an attempted Iranian attack on American troops, marking further escalation in the Middle East.
